title: Ruflo — 60 AI Agents Working Together For Free On GitHub
description:
This tool is trending number one on GitHub right now —
and almost nobody has set it up yet.

Ruflo turns a single Claude Code instance into a distributed 
multi-agent environment — a swarm of specialized AI agents 
coordinating in parallel to build, test, and ship faster 
than any single-agent workflow. 

Here's exactly what it does 👇

✅ 60+ pre-built agents — researcher, coder, tester, security reviewer, 
DevOps engineer, data analyst — all running simultaneously 
✅ Queen agent manages all other agents — full hierarchy
✅ Collective memory — agents improve every single time you run them
✅ Slashes Claude API costs by 75% — routes basic tasks to free tier 
✅ 100% open source — zero subscriptions needed

59,000 GitHub stars as of June 2026 — exceptional community growth.
